fields.name: Deductor's Email ID
fields.remark: Valid E-mail  should be provided. 1. Email format must be checked -atleast @ and '.' should be mentioned.  2. E-mail id of deductor/collector or person responsible for deducting/collecting tax should be provided.

fields.name: Total tax Deducted
fields.remark: Mention the amount of "Income Tax" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total Interest
fields.remark: Mention the amount of "Interest" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total fee
fields.remark: Mention the amount of "Fee" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total Penalty/ Others
fields.remark: Mention the amount of "Penalty" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan/Total Amount adjusted through Book Adjustment (Total of values in B+C+D+E)
fields.remark: Mention the amount of 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.  Value in this field should be equal to total of values in column numbers B, C, D, E

fields.name: Mode of payment of tax (by way of challan/by way of book adjustment)
fields.remark: Allowed values C or B If Transfer Voucher Number is provided this is mandatory and only allowed value is 'B'. If Bank Challan Number is provided , then mention value as "C". For a Nil statement no value to be provided. Value 'C' to be provided, if values under field no. 15 of DD details are '1059', '1033', '1037', '1038' or '1061'.

fields.name: Last BSR Code/ Form 24G Receipt Number ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
BSR Code/ Form 24G Receipt Number
fields.remark: In case TDS deposited by  1) Challan:BSR Code of the receiving branch 2) Book Adjustment: Quote seven digit receipt number provided by AO. Applicable for govt. deductor/ collector where TDS is deposited by book entry.  3) No value to be quoted in case of Nil Statement (value in field "NIL Challan Indicator" field is "Y").

fields.name: Last Bank Challan No/DDO Serial Number ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Bank Challan No/DDO Serial Number
fields.remark: Challan Number issued by Bank if value in field G is C DDO Serial Number if value in column G is B  Applicable to both Govt and Non Govt, Non-Nil statements.  No value is required to be provided in case of a NIL return (I.e. the cases in which the value in field 'NIL Challan Indicator' is "Y").

fields.name: Last Date of 'Bank Challan No / DDO Serial Number' ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Date of 'Bank Challan / Transfer Voucher' (DDMMYYYY)
fields.remark: Date of payment of tax to Govt. It can be any date on or after 1st April of immediate previous financial year for which the return is prepared. Value should be equal to last date of respective quarter if the value in field "NIL Challan Indicator" is "Y".  Date of 'Bank Challan / Book Adjustment' should be within the respective quarter for which statement is being filed, in case of minor head code value selected under field no. 23 is '100'. Also this date has to be on or before date present under field 'Date on which Amount paid / Credited' field no. 19 of DD record (which is mapped to this challan with minor head code value '100')

fields.remark: Running serial number for 'Challan Detail' records in a batch.

fields.name: Last deductee PAN ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Deductee's PAN
fields.remark: PAN of the Employee. If available should be Valid PAN Format. There may be Employees who have not been issued PAN however who have applied for a PAN and have given adequate declaration to the deductor indicating the same.  In such cases, deduction schedule in the statement will not reflect PAN and instead state PAN Ref. Number for the Employee.  The deductor will however have to mention ‘PANAPPLIED’ in place of PAN. If the Employee is not sure of the PAN format he will have to mention 'PANINVALID'.  However if the Employee has not given any declaration, deductor will have to mention ‘PANNOTAVBL’ in place of PAN.    For section codes '1059', '1033', '1037', '1038' or '1061', no default PAN values should be allowed under this field. That means default PAN values in case of non-availablity of valid PAN ('PANNOTAVBL', 'PANAPPLIED', 'PANINVALID') will not be allowed for these sections.

fields.remark: Mention the Name of the deductee.

Date of payment / Credited (dd/mm/yyyy)

fields.name: Amount Paid/ Credited
fields.remark: Mention the Amount paid to deductee. Value should always be greater than 0.00

fields.remark: Mandatory to mention value under this field only when value under field Section Code (field no. 15) of DD records is "section 393(3), i.e. section code 1064", else no value should be specified.

fields.name: Amount of cash withdrawal which is in excess of Rs. 3 Crore for cases covered by section 393(3) [Table: Sl. No. 5] (in case of co- operative societies)
fields.remark: Mandatory to mention value under this field only when value under field Section Code (field no. 15) of DD records is "section 393(3), i.e. section code 1064", else no value should be specified.

fields.name: Total Tax Deducted
fields.remark: Decimal with precision value 2 is allowed.  In case value present under field 15 is 1059', '1033', '1037', '1038' or '1061', then value under this field should be 0.00.

fields.name: Total Tax Deposited
fields.remark: Decimal with precision value 2 is allowed.  In case value present under field 15 is 1059', '1033', '1037', '1038' or '1061', then value under this field should be 0.00.

fields.name: Last total Tax deducted (Used for Verification) (Not Applicable)
Date of deduction (dd/mm/yyyy)
fields.remark: Date of tax deduction. Mandatory  if 'Total tax deducted' is greater than Zero (0.00) . No value needs to be specified if 'Total Tax Deducted' is Zero (0.00) . Date to be mentioned in DDMMYYYY format. Also, this date should not be less than the relevant quarter. E.g. If the statement is being prepared for Q2 of Tax Year 2026-27, then date of deduction should be greater than or equal to 01/07/2026.

fields.name: Rate at which Tax Deducted
fields.remark: Rate at which Tax is deducted, with  decimal precision of 4 point. E.g. if the rate is 2 then the same should be mentioned as 2.0000. If value in field 'Total tax collected' is 0.00 then rate at which tax deducted should be 0.0000 In case value present under field 15 is 1059', '1033', '1037', '1038' or '1061', then value under this field should be 0.00.

fields.name: Unique Identification  Number of Form No.  121 submitted by the  deductee
fields.remark: Mention value of Unique Identification Number of Form No. 121

fields.name: Reason for non-deduction / Lower deduction / Higher deduction / Threshold / Transporter etc.
